notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Village Bell-Ringer.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.
